description:
In the WordPress admin panel (already open in Firefox), edit the existing 'About Us' page by navigating to Pages in the left sidebar.

**Title Change (REQUIRED):** Change the page title from 'About Us' to 'About Our Team'

**New Content Section (REQUIRED):** Add a new section at the END of the page (do NOT replace existing content). This section must have:
1. A HEADING (use Heading block or H2/H3) with the text 'Our Values'
2. A LIST (use List block or bullet list) containing these three items:
   - Innovation
   - Integrity
   - Excellence

**IMPORTANT:** The values must be in a proper bulleted/numbered list format, not just plain text.

**Final Step (REQUIRED):** Click the Update button to save the changes.

This task will only succeed if: the title is changed, 'Our Values' is a proper heading (not plain text), and all three values are in a list structure.
